title: fix(jaspic): restore baseline fields safety guard
purpose: 通知・メール配信とその運用に関する変更
purpose_basis: 変更パスと表題による分類（意味の確定には原文を確認）
body:
Closes #229

Restore `BASELINE_FIELDS_MISSING` in `productionPlan` for existing records with incomplete snapshot fields. Newly published IDs are not rejected merely for older occurrence dates. Add focused regression tests.

Issue preflight REVIEW_RECORDED: https://github.com/miyazaki1016/emergencyalert/actions/runs/43353877347
